== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Murrok refers to both an independent planet and a specific individual. The planet is a highly inhospitable world with minimal connections to the rest of the galaxy, rivaling [[Dornoth IV]] in its harshness. According to ancient legends, the planet was once orbited by a dark moon that periodically appeared to provide gifts, though this celestial body disappeared nearly a millennium ago. The [[inhabitants]] of Murrok are known for their self-sufficiency, preferring to trade tangible commodities like ships, plants used for terraforming, and low-grade [[Aethertech]] [[water]] purifiers rather than accepting services. The individual named Murrok is a being with diamond eyes and a beard of smoke, capable of producing sounds like humming or rumbling. He possesses the ability to change his eye color to red when angry and has been associated with the title of [[World Spirit]].}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Murrok is an independent planet located within the [[Free Worlds]] and serves as a destination noted by Mell D-One-Twenty-Five{{!}}Mell. This [[World Spirit]] is an inhospitable place that rivals [[Dornoth IV]] for the title of the galaxy's worst planet, featuring oceans composed of dull, brown sludge and an atmosphere choked by toxic volcanic clouds. The planet's native life consists primarily of insectoid creatures, while the entity itself possesses eyes made of large diamonds, teeth of pale [[stone]], and a tongue of soil. During its interactions, Murrok claimed that [[the Advocates]] are unaware of the true nature of what they hold regarding the [[Shadow Ark]].}}
